prompt: You have a history test in two weeks and a chapter to learn. Which practice is most likely to make the facts stick?

options.text: Close the book, write down everything you can recall, then check what you missed
Re-read the chapter three times, highlighting the key lines each time
Copy the chapter summary out neatly by hand
Listen once while a classmate reads their notes aloud

explanation: Trying to recall material from memory, then checking the gaps, strengthens retention far more than re-reading or copying, which can feel familiar without being well learned.
